context_chunks.text: Minor keying error. Treat as a paid parking event with a registration mismatch and apply the applicable Code/keying-error requirements. Keying and payment are one case theory - do not repeat.

Keeper liability threshold. Keeper liability is not automatic. If the operator seeks recovery from the keeper under Schedule 4, the applicable statutory conditions must be satisfied. State that liability cannot be transferred to the keeper under Schedule 4. Do not say the underlying charge is automatically invalid merely because keeper liability fails.

sources.title: Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 Schedule 4
sources.note: Keeper liability only. Apply the correct notice route and statutory requirements.

context_chunks.text: The discrepancy concerns a minor registration-entry error. Payment was nevertheless made. The operator should match the transaction and deal with the case in accordance with the applicable current keying-error requirements.

Driver not established. If Schedule 4 conditions are not met and the driver has not been established, the operator cannot transfer the driver's liability to the registered keeper under Schedule 4. Never invite or infer driver identity. This is the conclusion that follows a verified finding, not a free-standing ground.
